notes: GAAP county, governmental activities only, no business-type funds (business_type null). Receipts/disbursements from p6 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column. Homestead taxes categorized as intergovernmental/state aid. Payments in lieu of tax is 1,571,018 on p6 (1,571,017 on p4). Debt_proceeds = leases + subscriptions issued (both shown as other financing sources). Balance sheet uses p3 government-wide Statement of Net Position (only a Governmental Activities column, which is the total primary government). ending_cash is the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p5) cash and pooled investments, total column; restricted assets of 54,143,934 are separate. Detail (user 2026-10-27, like Lincoln): major funds (General, Road, Health Center, DC Justice Center) from the p6 GAAP fund columns (budget-basis schedules pp7-11 no longer used); nonmajor special revenue funds from the p12-13 combining statement; other nonmajor funds (combining pages not trimmed) as the p6 Nonmajor column minus the special revenue total. Detail ties to the p6 Total Governmental Funds column.
